_readme: One entry per horse. Copy an entry, change the fields and rebuild. 'sample: true' marks design-preview content - it is labelled on the site, excluded from the sitemap and hidden when site.json 'showSampleHorses' is false. Use null for anything not yet verified; it will be hidden or shown as 'To be confirmed'. status: available | racing | in-training | fully-subscribed | retired | sold.

horses.name: Sample Horse I
horses.summary: Sample listing showing how a horse available for syndication will appear. Replace with the horse's real profile.
horses.introduction: This is placeholder text for a horse's introduction - its character, its preparation so far and what the syndicate hopes to achieve with it. It does not describe a real horse.

horses.name: Sample Horse II
horses.summary: Sample listing showing a horse that is already racing for the syndicate, with its record and recent runs.
horses.introduction: Placeholder introduction for a horse already racing. Real profiles will include verified race results and approved training updates.

recentRuns.notes: Example row - not a real result.

updates.title: Sample training update
updates.text: Example of an approved training or career update from the yard. Not a real update.

horses.name: Sample Horse III
horses.summary: Sample listing showing how a fully subscribed horse is marked, with an invitation to register interest in future opportunities.
horses.introduction: Placeholder introduction for a horse whose shares have all been taken up.
